subject: Parent Alert: Student Attendance Concern - $student_name
body:
Dear $parent_name,

We are writing to inform you about an attendance concern regarding your child, $student_name (Student ID: $student_id).

Attendance Details:
Module: $module_name
Current Attendance Rate: $attendance_percentage%
Required Minimum: 90%
Total Sessions: $total_sessions
Attended: $attended_sessions
Absent: $absent_sessions

The student's attendance has fallen below the required threshold. Regular attendance is crucial for academic success and may affect:
- Understanding of course material
- Eligibility for assessments
- Overall academic performance
- Progression to the next academic year

We encourage you to:
1. Discuss attendance with your child
2. Identify any barriers to regular attendance
3. Contact the school if there are extenuating circumstances
4. Work with us to develop an improvement plan

If you have any questions or concerns, please contact:
- Module Instructor: $instructor_email
- Student Support Services: support@university.edu
- Attendance Office: attendance@university.edu

You can view detailed attendance records through the Parent Portal.

Thank you for your cooperation in supporting your child's education.

Best regards,
$signature
